old_title: Greens leader Larissa Waters steps down due to illness

old_text:
Larissa Waters stepping down as Greens leader due to illness
In short:
Greens leader Larissa Waters has stepped down from the top job due to a chronic kidney condition.
Senator Waters will take a leave of absence as she focuses on her health before returning to her upper house duties.
What's next?
The Greens partyroom will meet in the coming days to discuss who will replace Senator Waters.
